text:
All tests pass.

**Root cause:** `LRUCache.__getitem__` never called `__touch(key)`, so reading a value (via `cache[key]` or `.get`) didn't update its recency order — only `__setitem__` did. This made eviction depend solely on insertion order, i.e. FIFO behavior instead of LRU.

**Fix:** Updated `LRUCache.__getitem__` to call `self.__touch(key)` after a successful lookup, guarded by `if key in self` so it doesn't try to touch a key that `__missing__` chose not to store (preserving the existing `test_missing_getsizeof` behavior).

All tests pass.

**Root cause:** `LRUCache.__getitem__` never called `__touch(key)`, so reading a value (via `cache[key]` or `.get`) didn't update its recency order — only `__setitem__` did. This made eviction depend solely on insertion order, i.e. FIFO behavior instead of LRU.

**Fix:** Updated `LRUCache.__getitem__` to call `self.__touch(key)` after a successful lookup, guarded by `if key in self` so it doesn't try to touch a key that `__missing__` chose not to store (preserving the existing `test_missing_getsizeof` behavior).
